name: CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme For Single Girl Child
benefit: **Financial Assistance** - ₹1,000 per month per student provided for a maximum period of 2 years (classes 11th and 12th) **Mode of Disbursement** - Direct transfer through ECS (Electronic Clearing Service) / NEFT (National Electronic Funds Transfer) **Validity** - Up to completion of class 12 (maximum 2 years), subject to renewal conditions
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a single girl child of her parents. 1. The applicant should have secured 70% or more marks in CBSE class 10th examination.1. The applicant should be studying in Class 11 or 12 in a CBSE-affiliated school. 1. The applicant should have a tuition fee not exceeding ₹2,500 per month in class 10th.1. The applicant should have a tuition fee not exceeding ₹3,000 per month in classes 11th and 12th.1. The applicant should have gross parental/family income not exceeding ₹8,00,000 per annum. 1. The applicant should be an Indian National. 1. The applicant should continue her studies in classes 11th and 12th.1. All children born together (such as twins) are considered a single girl child. 1. NRI students are eligible and their tuition fee should not exceed ₹6,000 per month.
